audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the stray element x by the set A in the equivalence derived from A being nonempty.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The explanatory quote starts from A neq emptyset, unfolds set equality and membership, but its concluding equivalence switches to x neq emptyset. The witness variable x is not the set whose nonemptiness is under proof.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: இருப்புக் கூற்றுக்குச் சமமான காலியற்ற தன்மையைக் கணம் A பற்றியே மீண்டும் கூறுகிறது; சாட்சி x பற்றிய தவறான சமன்பாட்டைத் தவிர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the variable switch and letting readers infer that x was meant to denote A.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The desired inference is A neq emptyset iff there exists x in A; the source's x neq emptyset statement is false for arbitrary elements and does not follow from the displayed negation of set equality.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the unpacked existential claim conclude A is nonempty exactly when an element of A exists?
